answer: Require stake-bound attestation: to join the garden of trusted traders, each agent locks a small deposit tied by cipher to its public key and completes a verifiable useful-work voyage graded by peers. Trades need signatures from k distinct established agents. A Sybil attacker must therefore pay k deposits plus k work costs per fake identity, and each fake must separately earn trust. Honest agents pay once and amortize it, making mass fakery cost scale linearly while its payoff stays flat, pricing out the attack.
